_about: Command-line agents the eval runner can drive. Add one with its command; see tools/agents/command.py. The entries below are templates: check each agent's own CLI flags before relying on them.

hermes.about: Hermes Agent (Nous Research): one non-interactive turn against a local OpenAI-compatible model server ($KW_LOCAL_BASE_URL, default http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1); --model is the name that server serves. --ignore-user-config skips ~/.hermes/config.yaml and every provider in it, so the provider is given here ('custom' = any OpenAI-compatible server; the key is a placeholder a keyless local server ignores). --yolo is required headless: without it an approval prompt blocks the run. With these flags Hermes Agent 0.23.0 on Ubuntu (llama-server) read a file and answered in a headless turn

openclaw.about: OpenClaw: 'agent exec', its recommended headless entry point, in the task folder; flags from its CLI docs, not run on this machine

perplexity-computer.about: Perplexity Computer, driven by a person in its app: the runner stages each prompt and waits
